page.overview:
What is Coliseum?

Coliseum is a battle arena in Final Fantasy Dimensions. The Warriors of Light can first access it during Chapter 3, but the area is closed. In Chapter 4, the party can make full use of it and win various prizes by beating three consecutive battles.

The entrance fee to the arena is 1000 Gil. The party has to fight three battles in a row. Below is the list of possible enemies the party can encounter.
